meta_title: Apply for a Bed — TrueNorth Living, North Texas
meta_description: Apply for a sober living bed in Dallas, Denton, or Arlington. Takes about five minutes. We respond the same day, usually within an hour.
hero_body: Five minutes, twelve questions, no account to create. We read every one of these ourselves and respond the same day — usually within the hour.
reassurance: You can apply for yourself or for someone else.
Nothing here is a commitment. It starts a conversation.
We don't share your information with treatment centers, marketers, or anyone else. Ever.
If it's easier to just call, call. The number is at the top of this page.
success_body: Someone from TrueNorth will reach out today. If it's urgent, call us now rather than waiting on the reply.

after.detail: We call or text you back and ask a few follow-up questions.
A short phone interview — mostly us listening — and a straight answer on availability.
Usually within 48 hours of approval. Bring clothes, medication, and ID. We'll cover the rest on day one.
